ReadMe.Statement: DRAFT v0.1 — companion registry authored 2026-09-05 from the RATIFIED KG Layer 2 section of the AIVIA Design Document (protocol step 2). The doc is the authority; any doc change updates this registry in the same breath. All build deferred by the phase ruling.
One tree per SQL FILE; #temp = internal scope; no smallest-unit-of-logic ever defined.
Subsumes the doc's 'logic contract (tbd)' pointer: the mapper's seam obligations are the Rules_to_Checks sheet.

Node_Types.Properties: physical name, source path, dialect, parsed_at, parser/metamodel versions

Node_Types.Notes: parser-defined executable command; ordered; control-flow blocks nest statements
SELECT+clauses, CTE, subquery, temp-table stage — every logic boundary
FROM, JOIN w/ type, WHERE, HAVING, GROUP BY, ORDER BY/TOP, UNION w/ dedup, CASE

Node_Types.Properties: kind: column_ref | table_ref | literal | parameter_ref | function | arithmetic | unary | case | cast | subquery_ref
Node_Types.Notes: refs are mentions; resolution is an edge

Edge_Types.From -> To: parent -> child through the whole tree (incl. statement->statement for control flow)
Edge_Types.Properties: position (where order is meaning); role (predicate->expression only: subject|comparand|lower_bound|upper_bound|pattern|escape|selection|quantifier)

Edge_Types.Notes: column_ref->KG1 column; table_ref->KG1 table OR same-tree scope (staging chain for free); parameter_ref->parameter; subquery_ref->scope; unresolvable = NO edge, counted

Rules_to_Checks.Check asserts: no text-parsing constructs in the mapper's dependency graph (AST plank)
handled ⊎ remainder = total per file; unknown vendor construct = red build via reflected denominator
every node carries verbatim fragment + location
derived-table fixture: inner predicate owned by inner scope
resolution census per file; unresolved counted; completeness declared
writer census; rebuild from sources+KG1 = deep-equal
every node/edge validates against this registry
no consumer parses fragment text outside the mapper (AST plank)

Fixture_Families.Cases: one smallest file per grammar kind -> authored expected tree + empty remainder
OR shapes · derived-table scope · RANGE over columns · IN_SELECTION value sets · CTE referenced twice (DAG) · temp staging chain · 1=1 · CASE-in-predicate · negated forms (R1) · nested control flow
each deferred construct -> exactly that counted remainder
same meaning, two dialects -> identical trees modulo evidence (arrives with dialect #2)

Lifecycle.Writer / trigger: the MAPPER only; estate file intake (trigger cites the estate-source seam — H3 uncontracted)
Lifecycle.Postconditions: full tree per metamodel; conservation handled ⊎ remainder = total; evidence on every node; resolution complete (edges or counted); name-keyed identities minted
Lifecycle.Tests: LC2-C1 authored file -> authored tree · LC2-C2 unmappable construct -> counted remainder, tree whole · LC2-C3 unresolvable ref -> no edge, counted

Lifecycle.Writer / trigger: the mapper; re-parse of a known source path
Lifecycle.Postconditions: new tree version appended, prior retired; name-keyed identities stable where names persist; content-key drift as evidence; attachments to persisting names undisturbed. resolves_to binds to IDENTITY not version — L1 supersession needs zero re-resolution
Lifecycle.Tests: LC2-S1 edit inside scope -> identity + attachment survive, drift flagged (= scenario S1) · LC2-S2 rename -> old retired, new minted, attachment surfaces for human re-attach · LC2-S3 unchanged file -> no new version

Lifecycle.Writer / trigger: the mapper; source path absent from estate
Lifecycle.Postconditions: whole tree retired, never removed; attachments surface
Lifecycle.Tests: LC2-R1 deleted file -> retired tree + surfaced attachments

Lifecycle.Postconditions: any writer but mapper (LC2-F1 census) · text-derived structure (LC2-F2 parser-authority plank) · hand edits (LC2-F3) · physical delete (LC2-F4) · partial parse shipped whole (LC2-F5 — conservation IS the atomicity)

Scope_Identity.Definition: All eight flags RULED 2026-09-05 (Sunny): this sheet restates the doc's Disambiguation models A3/A4 and register row A11 as registry rows. Doc is authority; transcribed verbatim-in-substance.
key(scope_i) := file :: name if i = 1st occurrence of name in file order; file :: name#i otherwise. Total over all scopes with names.
Scope_Identity.Branch / witness: Branch (explicit, counted): removing occurrence 1 retires ALL keys of that name; survivors re-mint; displaced attachments surface for re-attach. Witness: two WITH Base -> Base, Base#2; edit elsewhere changes neither.

Scope_Identity.Definition: the file's final emitter scope mints file :: delivery (single emitter); plural emitters mint file :: delivery_1..n in statement order AND surface on the DBA list.
Scope_Identity.Branch / witness: register A11 (RULED 2026-09-05); witnessed by fixtures F2 expected_trees + F3 decisions_membership keys.

Scope_Identity.Definition: about-targets := named nodes only (file, named scope, KG1 nodes, layer-3 citizens, concepts). Unnamed nodes are outside the domain — a domain bound, not a branch.
Scope_Identity.Branch / witness: Witness: subquery logic is described at its named ancestor.

Meaning_Twin.Definition: twin-graph ruling (2026-09-06) 2c/2e: KG2b, the meaning graph — the parsed graph's homomorphic twin, built only by the TRANSLATOR. Doc is authority.
the translated meaning material (steward-voiced words, resolved value meanings, composed phrases)
edge to exactly ONE KG2a node — the homomorphism; gap nodes point at the counted site, reason-coded
edges to every KG1 node consulted — derived meaning cites its sources; the object-grain staleness basis
meaning identity: hash over (kind, operand identities resolved to KG1 ids or scope paths, literal values, children's content_keys, join kind)
translated + gap == every KG2a node, no third bucket — queryable
composite nodes (scope, statement, file) translate by composing children's meanings — never a separate invention
INVARIANT to formatting/whitespace, alias names, AND/join order, comments; SENSITIVE to any column, operator, literal value, join kind, or structural change
regenerates with KG2a at the FILE quantum; a version bump regenerates the whole layer
the A12 deferral LIFTED — SELECT list enters KG2a as a structure kind, one projection-member node per output column
